correctness.rationale: Graph-state character orthogonality gives entropy bits equal to F2 rank of crossing adjacency. For crossing subgraph of a path (forest), unique matching minor proves rank equals maximum matching size. Greedy path matching recurrence s_i=1[a_i≠a_{i+1}](1-s_{i-1}) is exact and yields four-state transfer w(z)T(z,t)^(n-1)1. Independent direct F2 Gaussian elimination on all 2^n cuts for n=4,6,8,10,12 agrees with transfer histogram and endpoints; n=12 gives (2,28,152,358,320,64). Analytically verified characteristic cubic λ[λ^3-(1+z)λ²+z(1-2t)λ+tz(z+1)] and logarithmic Hessian diag(1/4,2/27) at (1,1). Complement symmetry fixes half-population saddle, strict primitive Perron modulus separation away z=1 yields conditional quasi-powers with mean n/3+O(1), var 2n/27+O(1) and CLT. Perfect rank demands each disjoint matched pair cross, 2^m assignments; rank-one only two balanced step cuts when m>=2.
